body.input: So those are like human interpretable things like with a peacock, but I wonder, I'm sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: echoes of the same thing are there with more primitive organisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Especially your PR, like how you advertise yourself that you're worthy of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So one big advertisement is the fact that you survived it all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Let me give you one beautiful example of an algal bloom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And this can be a cyanobacteria, it's going to be in bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So if suddenly you pump nitrate or phosphate or something into the ocean and everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: goes green, you end up with all this algae growing there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: A viral infection or something like that can kill the entire bloom overnight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's not that the virus takes out everything overnight, it's that most of the cells in

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that bloom kill themselves before the virus can get onto them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's through a form of cell death called programmed cell death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we do the same things, it's how we have the different, the gaps between our fingers

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and so on, it's how we craft synapses in the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It is fundamental again to multicellular life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They have the same machinery in these algal blooms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do they know who dies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The answer is they will often put out a toxin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that toxin is kind of a challenge to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Either you can cope with the toxin or you can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you can cope with it, you form a spore and you will go on to become the next generation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You form a kind of a resistance spore, you sink down a little bit, you get out of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: way, you can't be attacked by a virus if you're a spore, or at least not so easily.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Whereas if you can't deal with that toxin, you pull the plug and you trigger your death

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: apparatus and you kill yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oh, so it's truly life and death selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's really, it's a challenge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And this is a bit like sexual selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're all pretty much genetically identical, but they've had different life histories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So, have you had a tough day?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Did you happen to get infected by this virus or did you run out of iron or did you get

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a bit too much sun?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Whatever it may be, if this extra stress of the toxin just pushes you over the edge, then

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you have this binary choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Either you're the next generation or you kill yourself now using the same machinery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's also actually exactly the way I approach dating, but that's probably why I'm single.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What about if we can step back DNA?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Just mechanism of storing information, RNA, DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How big of an invention was that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That seems to be fundamental to something deep within what life is, is the ability,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as you said, to store and propagate information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But then you also inferred that with your and your students' work that there's a deep

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: connection between the chemistry and the ability to have this kind of genetic information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How big of an invention is it to have a nice representation, nice hard drive for info to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: pass on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Huge, I suspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When I was talking about the code, you see the code in RNA as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: RNA almost certainly came first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's been an idea going back decades called the RNA world because RNA, in theory, can

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: copy itself and can catalyze reactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it kind of cuts out this chicken and egg loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So DNA, it's possible, is not that special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So RNA is the thing that does the work really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the code lies in RNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The code lies in the interactions between RNA and amino acids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it still is there today in the ribosome, for example, which is just kind of a giant

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: ribosome, which is to say it's an enzyme that's made of RNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So getting to RNA, I suspect, is probably not that hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But getting from RNA, there's multiple different types of RNA now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do you distinguish?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This is something where I actively think about how do you distinguish between a random population

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of RNA?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some of them go on to become messenger RNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This is the transcript of the code, of the gene that you want to make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some of them become transfer RNA, which is this kind of the unit that holds the amino

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: acid that's going to be polymerized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some of them become ribosomal RNA, which is the machine which is joining them all up together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do they discriminate themselves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is some kind of phase transition going on there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a difficult question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we're now in the region of biology where information is coming in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But the thing about RNA is very, very good at what it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: By the largest genomes supported by RNA are RNA viruses, like HIV, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're pretty small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so there's a limit to how complex life could be unless you come up with DNA, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: chemically is a really small change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But how easy it is to make that change, I don't really know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: As soon as you've got DNA, then you've got an amazingly stable molecule for information

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: storage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can do absolutely anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But how likely that transition from RNA to DNA was, I don't know either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How much possibility is there for variety in ways to store information?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because it seems to be very specific characteristics about the programming language of DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, there's a lot of work going on on what's called the Zeno DNA or RNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can we replace the bases themselves, the letters, if you like, in RNA or DNA?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can we replace the backbone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can we replace the sugar ribos or deoxyribose with a different sugar?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the answer is yes, you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Within limits, there's not an infinite space there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Arsenate doesn't really work if the bonds are not as strong as phosphate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's probably quite hard to replace phosphate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's possible to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is it because there was some form of selection that this is better than the other forms and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: there were lots of competing forms of information storage early on and this one was the one

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that worked out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: with and they work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I'm increasingly thinking it's that way, that we're channeled towards ribose, phosphate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and the bases that are used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Are you talking about JavaScript or the genetic code now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, I mean, it's almost...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Biology is underpinned by this kind of mess as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you look at the human genome and it's full of stuff that is really either broken or dysfunctional

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or was a virus once, whatever it may be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And somehow it works and maybe we need a lot of this mess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We know that some functional genes are taken from this mess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So what about...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You mentioned the predatory behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We talked about sex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What about violence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Predator and prey dynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When was that invented?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And poetic and biological ways of putting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do you describe predator-prey relationship?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is it a beautiful dance or is it a violent atrocity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, I guess it's both, isn't it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, when does it start?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It starts in bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You see these amazing predators.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Delavibrio is one that Lynn Margulis used to talk about a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's got a kind of a drill piece that drills through the wall and the membrane of the bacterium

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and then it effectively eats the bacterium from just inside the periplasmic space and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: makes copies of itself that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So that's straight predation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There are predators among bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So predation in that, sorry to interrupt, means you murder somebody and use their body

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as a resource in some way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But it's not parasitic in that you need them to be still alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, predation is you kill them really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Murder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a little bit of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: predator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So what we see if we go back 560, 570 million years before the Cambrian explosion, there

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is what's known as the Ediacaran fauna or sometimes they call Vendobionts, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a lovely name.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's not obvious that they're animals at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're stalked things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They often have fronds that look a lot like leaves with kind of fractal branching patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the thing is they're found sometimes geologists can figure out the environment that they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in and say, this is more than 200 meters deep because there's no sign of any waves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's no storm damage down here, this kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They were more than 200 meters deep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So they're definitely not photosynthetic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: These are animals and they're filter feeders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You know, sponges and corals and things are filter feeding animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're stuck to the spot and little bits of carbon that come their way, they filter

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it out and that's what they're eating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So no predation involved in this beyond stuff just dies anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it feels like a very gentle, rather beautiful, rather limited world, you might say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's not a lot going on there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And something changes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oxygen definitely changes during this period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Other things may have changed as well, but the next thing you really see in the fossil

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: record is the Cambrian explosion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And what do we see there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're now seeing animals that we would recognize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They've got eyes, they've got claws, they've got shells, they're plainly killing things

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or running away and hiding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so we've gone from a rather gentle but limited world to a rather vicious, unpleasant

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: world that we recognize and which leads to kind of arms races, evolutionary arms races.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Which again is something that when we think about a nuclear arms race, we think, Jesus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we don't want to go there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not done anybody any good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In some ways, maybe it does do good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't want to make an argument for nuclear arms, but predation as a mechanism forces

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: organisms to adapt to change to be better to escape or to kill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you need to eat, then you've got to eat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And a cheetah is not going to run at that speed unless it has to because the zebra is

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: capable of escaping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it leads to much greater feats of evolution would ever have been possible without it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And in the end, to a much more beautiful world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so it's not all bad by any means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But the thing is you can't have this if you don't have an oxygenated planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because it's all in the end, it's about how much energy can you extract from the food

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you eat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you don't have an oxygenated planet, you can get about 10% out, not much more than

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you've got an oxygenated planet, you can get about 40% out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that means you can have, instead of having one or two trophic levels, you can have five

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or six trophic levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that means things can eat things that eat other things and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you've gone to a level of ecological complexity, which is completely impossible in the absence

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of oxygen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This reminds me of the Hunter S. Thompson quote, that for every moment of triumph, for

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: every instance of beauty, many souls must be trampled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The history of life on earth, unfortunately, is that of violence, just the trillions and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: trillions of multi-cell organisms that were murdered in the struggle for survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a sorry statement, but yes, it's basically true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that somehow is a catalyst from an evolutionary perspective for creativity, for creating more

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and more complex organisms that are better and better at surviving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, survival of the fittest, if you just go back to that old phrase, means death of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the weakest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now what's fit, what's weak, these are terms that don't have much intrinsic meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But the thing is, evolution only happens because of death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One way to die is the constraints, the scarcity of the resources in the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But that seems to be not nearly as good of a mechanism for death than other creatures

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: roaming about in the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When I say environment, I mean like the static environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But then there's the dynamic environment of bigger things trying to eat you and use you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: for your energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It forces you to come up with a solution to your specific problem that is inventive and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is new and hasn't been done before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so it forces, I mean, literally change, literally evolution on populations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They have to become different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's interesting that humans have channeled that into more, I mean, I guess what humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: are doing is they're inventing more productive and safe ways of doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You know, this whole idea of morality and all those kinds of things, I think they ultimately

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: lead to competition versus violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because I think violence can have a cold, brutal, inefficient aspect to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But if you channel that into more controlled competition in the space of ideas, in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: space of approaches to life, maybe you can be even more productive than evolution is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because evolution is very wasteful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Like the amount of murder required to really test a good idea, genetically speaking, is

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: just a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In many, many, many generations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Morally, we cannot base society on the way that evolution works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's the convention, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But actually, in some respects, we do, which is to say, this is how science works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have competing hypotheses that have to get better, otherwise they die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's the way that society works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In ancient Greece, we had the Athens and Sparta and city states, and then we had the Renaissance

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and nation states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And universities compete with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Tremendous amount of companies competing with each other all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It drives innovation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if we want to do it without all the death that we see in nature, then we have to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: some kind of societal level control that says, well, hit the limits guys, and these are what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the limits are going to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And society as a whole has to say, right, we want to limit the amount of death here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: so you can't do this and you can't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And who makes up these rules and how do we know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a tough thing, but it's basically trying to find a moral basis for avoiding the death

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of evolution and natural selection and keeping the innovation and the richness of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I forgot who said it, but that murder is illegal, probably Kurt Vonnegut.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Murder is illegal except when it's done to the sound of trumpets and at a large scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So we still have wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But we are struggling with this idea that murder is a bad thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's so interesting how we're channeling the best of the evolutionary imperative and trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to get rid of the stuff that's not productive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's trying to almost accelerate evolution, the same kind of thing that makes evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're trying to use that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think we naturally do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I don't think we can help ourselves do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Optimism as a form is basically about competition and differential rewards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But society and we have a, I keep using this word, moral obligation, but we cannot operate

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as a society if we go that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's interesting that we've had problems achieving balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So for example, in the financial crash in 2009, do you let banks go to the wall or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This kind of question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In evolution, certainly you let them go to the wall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And in that sense, you don't need the regulation because they just die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Whereas if we as a society think about what's required for society as a whole, then you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: don't necessarily let them go to the wall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In which case you then have to impose some kind of regulation that the bankers themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: will in an evolutionary manner exploit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, we've been struggling with this kind of idea of capitalism, the cold brutality

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of capitalism that seems to create so much beautiful things in this world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then the ideals of communism that seem to create so much brutal destruction in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We struggle with ideas of, well, maybe we didn't do it right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How can we do things better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then the ideas are the things we're playing with as opposed to people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If a PhD student has a bad idea, we don't shoot the PhD student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We just criticize their idea and hope they improve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You have a very humane lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know how you guys do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The way I run things, it's always life and death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it is interesting about humans that there is an inner sense of morality which begs the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: question of how did homo sapiens evolve?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If we think about the invention of early invention of sex and early invention of predation, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: was the thing invented to make humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What would you say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I suppose a couple of things I'd say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Number one is you don't have to wind the clock back very far, five, six million years or

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: so and let it run forwards again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the chances of humans as we know them is not necessarily that high.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Even as an alien, you find planet earth and it's got everything apart from humans on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's an amazing, wonderful, marvelous planet, but nothing that we would recognize as extremely

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: intelligent life and space faring civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So when we think about aliens, we're kind of after something like ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're after a space faring civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're not after zebras and giraffes and lions and things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Amazing though they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So the additional kind of evolutionary steps to go from large complex mammals, monkeys,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: let's say to humans doesn't strike me as that long a distance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's all about the brain and where's the brain and morality coming from it seems to me to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: be all about groups, human groups and interactions between groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The collective intelligence of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The interactions really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's a guy at UCL called Mark Thomas, who's done a lot of really beautiful work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think on this kind of question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I talk to him every now and then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So my views influenced by him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But a lot seems to depend on population density.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The more interactions you have going on between different groups, the more transfer of information

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: if you like between groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: People moving from one group to another group, almost like lateral gene transfer in bacteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The more expertise you're able to develop and maintain, the more culturally complex your

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: society can become.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And groups that have become detached, like on Easter Island for example, very often degenerate

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in terms of the complexity of their civilization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is that true for complex organisms in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Population density is often productive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Really matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In terms, I don't know what the actual factors were that were driving a large brain, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you can talk about fire, you can talk about tool use, you can talk about language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: None of them seem to correlate especially well with the actual known trajectory of human

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: evolution in terms of cave art and these kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That seems to work much better just with population density and number of interactions between

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: different groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: All of which is really about human interactions, human-human interactions and the complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But population density is the thing that increases the number of interactions, but then there

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: must have been inventions forced by that number of interactions that actually led to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So like Richard Wrangham talks about that it's basically the beta males had to beat

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: up the alpha male.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So that's what collaboration looks like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When you're living together, our early ancestors don't like the dictatorial aspect of a single

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: individual at the top of a tribe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So they learn to collaborate how to basically create a democracy of sorts, a democracy that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: prevents, minimizes or lessens the amount of violence, which essentially gives strength

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to the tribe and make the war between tribes versus the dictator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think one of the most wonderful things about humans is where all of those things, we are

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: deeply social as a species and we're also deeply selfish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems to me the conflict between capitalism and communism is really just two aspects of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: human nature, both of which are-

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have a constant kind of vying between the two sides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We really do care about other people beyond our families, beyond our immediate people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We care about society and the society that we live in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You could say that's a drawing towards socialism or communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: On the other side, we really do care about ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We really do care about our families, about working for something that we gain from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's the capitalist side of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're both really deeply ingrained in human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In terms of violence and interactions between groups, yes, all this dynamic of if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: interacting between groups, you can be certain that they're going to be burning each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and all kinds of physical violent interactions as well, which will drive the cleverness of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: how do you resist this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Let's build a tower.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Let's figure out what are we going to do to prevent being overrun by those marauding gangs

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: from over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You look outside humans and you look at chimps and bonobos and so on, and they're very, very

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: different structures to society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Chimps tend to have an aggressive alpha male type structure and bonobos, there's basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a female society where the males are predominantly excluded and only brought in at the behest

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of the female.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have a lot in common with both of those groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's again tension there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Probably chimps, more violence, bonobos, probably more sex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's another tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How serious do we want to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How much fun we want to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Asking for a friend again, what do you think happened to Neanderthals?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What did we cheeky humans do to the Neanderthals, homo sapiens?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do you think we murdered them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do we murder them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do we outcompete them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do we outmate them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I think there's unequivocal evidence that we mated with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We always try to mate with everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes, pretty much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's some interesting, the first sequences that came along were in mitochondrial DNA,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and that was back to about 2002 or thereabouts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What was found was that Neanderthal mitochondrial DNA was very different to human mitochondrial

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's so interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You could do a clock on it and they said the divergent state was about 600,000 years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or something like that, so not so long ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Then the first full genomes were sequenced maybe 10 years after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They showed plenty of signs of mating between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The mitochondrial DNA effectively says no mating, and the nuclear genes say, yeah, lots

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of mating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's not possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can you explain the difference between mitochondrial DNA and nucleus?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I've talked before about the mitochondria, which are the power packs in cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: These are the paired down control units that is their DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's passed on by the mother only.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In the egg cell, we might have half a million copies of mitochondrial DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's only 37 genes left, and they do basically the control unit of energy production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's what it's doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a basic old school machine that does-

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's got genes that were considered to be effectively trivial because they did a very

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: narrowly defined job, but they're not trivial in the sense that that narrowly defined job

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is about everything that is being alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So they're much easier to sequence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You've got many more copies of these things, and you can sequence them very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But the problem is because they go down only the maternal line from mother to daughter,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: your mitochondrial DNA and mine is going nowhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Any kids we have, they get their mother's mitochondrial DNA, except in very, very rare

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and strange circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so it tells a different story, and it's not a story which is easy to reconcile always.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What it seems to suggest to my mind at least is that there was one way traffic of genes

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: probably going from humans into Neanderthals rather than the other way around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318
