body.input: Why did the Neanderthals disappear?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I suspect they were probably less violent, less clever, less populous, less

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: willing to fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I think it probably drove them to extinction at the margins of Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's interesting how much, if we ran Earth over and over again, how many of these branches

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of intelligent beings that have figured out some kind of how to leverage collective intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: which ones of them emerge, which ones of them succeed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is it the more violent ones?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is it the more isolated ones?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Like what dynamics result in more productivity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I suppose we will never know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The more complex the organism, the harder it is to run the experiment in the lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And in some respects, maybe it's best if we don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The truth might be very painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What about if we actually step back a couple of interesting things that we humans do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One is object manipulation and movement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And of course, movement was something that was done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That was another big invention, being able to move around the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the other one is this sensory mechanism, how we sense the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One of the coolest high definition ones is vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How big are those inventions in the history of life on Earth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Vision movement, I mean, again, extremely important going back to the origin of animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the Cambrian explosion where suddenly you're seeing eyes in the fossil record.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can, it's not necessarily, again, lots of people historically have said what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: use is half an eye?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can go in a series of steps from a light sensitive spot on a flat piece of tissue

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to an eyeball with a lens and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you assume no more than, I don't remember this, but this was a specific model that I

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: have in mind, but it was a 1% change or half a percent change for each generation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How long would it take to evolve an eye as we know it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the answer is half a million years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It doesn't have to take long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's not how evolution works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's not an answer to the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It just shows you can reconstruct the steps and you can work out roughly how it can work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's not that big a deal to evolve an eye, but once you have one, then there's no way

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to hide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And again, we're back to predator prey relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're back to all the benefits that being able to see brings you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you think philosophically what bats are doing with the eco location and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I have no idea, but I suspect that they form an image of the world in pretty much the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: way that we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's just a matter of mental reconstruction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I suppose the other thing about sight, there are single celled organisms that have

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: got a lens and a retina and a cornea and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Basically they've got a camera type eye in a single cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They don't have a brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What they understand about their world is impossible to say, but they're capable of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: coming up with the same structures to do so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I suppose then is that once you've got things like eyes, then you have a big driving

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: pressure on the central nervous system to figure out what it all means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we come around to your other point about manipulation, sensory input and so on about

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now you have a huge requirement to understand what your environment is and what it means

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and how it reacts and where you should run away and where you should stay put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Actually, on that point, I don't know if you know the work of Donald Hoffman who uses the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: argument, the mechanism of evolution to say that there's not necessarily a strong evolutionary

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: value to seeing the world as it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Also objective reality, that our perception actually is very different from what's objectively

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're living inside an illusion and we're basically the entire set of species on earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think, I guess are competing in a space that's an illusion that's distinct from, that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: far away from physical reality as it is, as defined by physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm not sure it's an illusion so much as a bubble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have a sensory input, which is a fraction of what we could have a sensory input on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and we interpret it in terms of what's useful for us to know to stay alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So yes, it's an illusion in that sense, but the tree is physically there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you walk into that tree, it's not purely a delusion, there's some physical reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's a sensory slice into reality as it is, but because it's just a slice, you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: missing a big picture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But he says that that slice doesn't necessarily need to be a slice, it could be a complete

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: fabrication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's just consistent amongst the species, which is an interesting, or at least it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a humbling realization that our perception is limited and our cognitive abilities are

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: limited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And at least to me, it's argument from evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know how strong that is as an argument, but I do think that life can exist in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In the same way that you can do a virtual reality video game and you can have a vibrant

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: life inside that place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that place is not real in some sense, but you can still have a vibe, all the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: forces of evolution, all the same competition, the dynamics between humans you can have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I don't know if there's evidence for that being the thing that happened on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems that earth...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think in either environment, I wouldn't deny that you could have exactly the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that you talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it would be very difficult to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The idea in Matrix movies and so on that the whole world is completely a construction and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we're fundamentally deluded, it's difficult to say that's impossible or couldn't happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And certainly we construct in our minds what the outside world is, but we do it on input

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and that input, I would hesitate to say it's not real because it's precisely how we do

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: understand the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We have eyes, but if you keep someone in...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Apparently this kind of thing happens, someone kept in a dark room for five years or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: like that and they never see properly again because the neural wiring that underpins how

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we interpret vision never developed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You need, when you watch a child develop, it walks into a table, it bangs his head on

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the table and it hurts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now you've got two inputs, you've got one pain from this sharp edge and number two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you probably, you've touched it and realized it's there, it's a sharp edge and you've got

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the visual input and you put the three things together and think, I don't want to walk into

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a table again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you're learning and it's a limited reality, but it's a true reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you don't learn that properly, then you will get eaten, you will get hit by a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: bus, you will not survive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And same, if you're in some kind of, let's say, computer construction of reality, I'm

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: not in my ground here, but if you construct the laws that this is what reality is inside

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: this, then you play by those laws.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: As long as the laws are consistent, so just like you said in the lab, the interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: thing about the simulation question, yes, it's hard to know if we're living inside a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: simulation, but also yes, it's possible to do these kinds of experiments in the lab now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: More and more to me, the interesting question is how realistic does a virtual reality game

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: need to be for us to not be able to tell the difference?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: A more interesting question to me is how realistic or interesting does a virtual reality world

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: need to be in order for us to want to stay there forever or much longer than physical

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: reality, prefer that place and also prefer it not as we prefer hard drugs, but prefer

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it in a deep, meaningful way, in a way we enjoy life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I suppose the issue with the matrix, I imagine that it's possible to delude the mind sufficiently

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that you genuinely in that way do think that you are interacting with the real world when

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in fact the whole thing's a simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How good does the simulation need to be to be able to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, it needs to convince you that all your sensory input is correct and accurate and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: joins up and makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now that sensory input is not something that we're born with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're born with a sense of touch, we're born with eyes and so on, but we don't know how

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to use them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We don't know what to make of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We go around, we bump into trees, we cry a lot, we're in pain a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're basically booting up the system so that it can make head a tale of the sensory input

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that it's getting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That sensory input is not just a one-way flux of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's also you have to walk into things, you have to hear things, you have to put it together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now if you've got just babies in the matrix who are slotted into this, I don't think they

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: have that kind of sensory input.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't think they would have any way to make sense of New York as a world that they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: part of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The brain is just not developed in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, I can't make sense of New York in this physical reality either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But you said pain and the walking into things, well, you can create a pain signal and as

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: long as it's consistent that certain things result in pain, you can start to construct

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There are some, maybe you disagree with this, but I think we are born almost with a desire

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to be convinced by our reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Like a desire to make sense of our reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oh, I'm sure we are, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So there's an imperative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So whatever that reality is given to us, like the table hurts, fire is hot, I think we want

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to be deluded in a sense that we want to make a simple, like Einstein's simple theory of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the thing around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We want that simplicity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so maybe the hunger for the simplicity is the thing that could be used to construct

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a pretty dumb simulation that tricks us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So maybe tricking humans doesn't require building a universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, I don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, this is not what I work on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I don't know how close to it we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I agree with you that, yeah, I'm not sure that it's a morally justifiable thing to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: but is it possible in principle?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it'd be very difficult, but I don't see why in principle it wouldn't be possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I agree with you that we try to understand the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We try to integrate the sensory inputs that we have, and we try to come up with a hypothesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that explains what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think, though, that we have huge input from the social context that we're in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We don't do it by ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We don't kind of blunder around in a universe by ourselves and understand the whole thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we're told by the people around us what things are and what they do, and language is coming

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in here and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it would have to be an extremely impressive simulation to simulate all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, simulate all of that, including the social construct, the spread of ideas and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the exchange of ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But those questions are really important to understand as we become more and more digital

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: creatures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems like the next step of evolution is us becoming partial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: All the same mechanisms we've talked about are becoming more and more plugged in into

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We're becoming cyborgs, and there's an interesting interplay between wires and biology, zeros

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and ones and the biological systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't think we'll have the luxury to see humans as disjoint from the technology we've

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: created for much longer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We are an organism that's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I agree with you, but we come really with this to consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And is there a distinction there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because what you're saying, the natural end point says we are indistinguishable, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: if you are capable of building an AI, which is sufficiently close and similar that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: merge with it, then to all intents and purposes, that AI is conscious as we know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't have a strong view, but I have a view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I wrote about it in the epilogue to my last book because 10 years ago, I wrote a chapter

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in a book called Life Ascending about consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The subtitle of Life Ascending was the 10 great inventions of evolution, and I couldn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: possibly write a book with a subtitle like that that did not include consciousness, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: specifically consciousness as one of the great inventions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It was in part because I was just curious to know more, and I read more for that chapter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I never worked on it, but I've always...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How can anyone not be interested in the question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I was left with the feeling that A, nobody knows, and B, there are two main schools of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: thought out there with a big skew in distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One of them says, oh, it's a property of matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's an unknown law of physics, panpsychism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Everything is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The sun is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's just a matter of how much, or a rock is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's just a matter of how much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I find that very unpersuasive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I can't say that it's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's just that I think we somehow can tell the difference between something that's living

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and something that's not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Then the other end is it's an emergent property of a very complex central nervous system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I never quite understand what people mean by words like emergence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There are genuine examples, but I think we very often tend to use it to plaster over

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: ignorance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: As a biochemist, the question for me then was, okay, it's a concoction of a central

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: nervous system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: A depolarizing neuron gives rise to a feeling, to a feeling of pain or to a feeling of love

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or anger, whatever it may be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What is then a feeling in biophysical terms in the central nervous system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Which bit of the wiring gives rise to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I've never seen anyone answer that question in a way that makes sense to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's an important question to answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think if we want to understand consciousness, that's the only question to answer because

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: certainly an AI is capable of out thinking and it's only a matter of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe it's already happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In terms of just information processing and computational skill, I don't think we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: any problem in designing a mind which is at least the equal of the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In terms of what we value the most as humans, which is to say our feelings, our emotions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: our sense of what the world is in a very personal way, that I think means as much or more to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: people than their information processing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's where I don't think that AI necessarily will become conscious because I think it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the property of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, let's talk about it more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You're an incredible writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One of my favorite writers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So let me read from your latest book, Transformers, what you write about consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think therefore I am, said Descartes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is one of the most celebrated lines ever written, but what am I exactly?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And artificial intelligence can think too by definition and therefore is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yet few of us could agree whether AI is capable in principle of anything resembling human

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: emotions, of love or hate, fear and joy, of spiritual yearnings for oneness or oblivion

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or corporeal pangs of thirst and hunger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The problem is we don't know what emotions are, as you were saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What is the feeling in physical terms?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How does a discharging neuron give rise to a feeling of anything at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This is the heart problem of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The seeming duality of mind and matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The physical makeup of our innermost self.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We can understand in principle how an extremely sophisticated parallel processing system could

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: be capable of wondrous feats of intelligence, but we can't answer in principle whether

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: such a supreme intelligence would experience joy or melancholy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What is the quantum of solace?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Speaking to the question of emergence, there's just technical, there's an excellent paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on this recently about the kind of phase transition emergence of performance in neural networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on the problem of NLP, natural language processing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So language models, there seems to be this question of size.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: At some point there is a phase transition as you grow the size of the neural network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So the question is, this is somewhat of a technical question that you can philosophize

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The technical question is, is there a size of a neural network that starts to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to form the kind of representations that can capture a language and therefore be able to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: not just language, but linguistically capture knowledge that's sufficient to solve a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of problems in language, like be able to have a conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There seems to be not a gradual increase, but a phase transition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're trying to construct the science of where that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What is a good size of a neural network and why does such a phase transition happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Anyway, that sort of points to emergence that there could be stages where a thing goes from

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: being your very intelligent toaster to a toaster that's feeling sad today and turns away and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: looks out the window, sighing, having an existential crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Thinking of Marvin the paranoid android.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Exactly, well no, Marvin is simplistic because Marvin is just cranky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So easily programmed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, easily programmed, nonstop existential crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You're almost basically, what is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Notes from Underground by Dusty Esquilades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Just constantly complaining about life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, they're capturing the full roller coaster of human emotion, the excitement, the bliss,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the connection, the empathy and all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then the selfishness, the anger, the depression, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They're capturing all of that and be able to experience it deeply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's the most important thing you could possibly experience today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The highest highs, the lowest lows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This is it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: My life will be over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I cannot possibly go on that feeling and then after a nap you're feeling amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That might be something that emerges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So why would a nap make an AI being feel better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: First of all, we don't know that for a human either, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But we do know that that's actually true for many people much of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe you're depressed and you have a nap and you do in fact feel better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oh, you are actually asking the technical question there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a biological answer to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so the question is whether AI needs to have the same kind of attachments to its body,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: bodily function and preservation of the brain's successful function, self-preservation essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in some deep biological sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: To my mind, it comes back around to the problem we were talking about before about simulations

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and sensory input and learning what all of this stuff means and life and death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That biology unlike society has a death penalty over everything and natural selection works

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on that death penalty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you make this decision wrongly, you die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the next generation is represented by beings that made a slightly different decision

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on balance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that is something that's intrinsically difficult to simulate in all this richness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I would say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So what is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Death in all its richness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Our relationship with death or the whole of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So when you say richness, of course, there's a lot in that, which is hard to simulate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What's part of the richness that's hard to simulate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I suppose the complexity of the environment and your position in that or the position

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of an organism in that environment, in the full richness of that environment over its

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: entire life, over multiple generations with changes in gene sequence over those generations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: so slight changes in the makeup of those individuals over generations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But if you take it back to the level of single cells, which I do in the book and ask how

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: does a single cell in effect know it exists as a unit, as an entity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, no, in inverted commas, obviously it doesn't know anything, but it acts as

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a unit and it acts with astonishing precision as a unit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I had suggested that that's linked to the electrical fields on the membranes themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and that they give some indication of how am I doing in relation to my environment as

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a kind of real time feedback on the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And this is something physical, which can be selected over generations that if you get

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: this wrong, it's linked with this set of circumstances that I've just, as an individual, I have a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: moment of blind panic and run as a bacterium or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You have some electrical discharge that says blind panic and it runs, whatever it may be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you associate over generations, multiple generations that this electrical phase that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm in now is associated with a response like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's easy to see how feelings come in through the back door almost with that kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of giving real time feedback on your position in the world in relation to how am I doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then you complexify the system and yes, I have no problem with phase transition and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: can all of this be done purely by the language, by the issues with how the system understands

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: itself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe it can, I honestly don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But the philosophers for a long time have talked about the possibility that you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: have a zombie intelligence and that there are no feelings there, but everything else

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I have to throw this back to you really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How do you deal with the zombie intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So first of all, I can see that from a biologist perspective, you think of all the complexities

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that led up to the human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The entirety of the history of 4 billion years that in some deep sense integrated the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: being into this environment and that dance of the organism and the environment, you could

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: see how emotions arise from that and their emotions are deeply connected, creating a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: human experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And from that you mix in consciousness and the full mess of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But from a perspective of an intelligent organism that's already here, like a baby that learns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it doesn't need to learn how to be a collection of cells or how to do all the things you need

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The basic function of a baby as it learns is to interact with its environment, to learn

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: from its environment, to learn how to fit in to the social society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the basic response of the baby is to cry a lot of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: To cry, to convince the humans to protect it or to discipline it, to teach it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We've developed a bunch of different tricks, how to get our parents to take care of us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to educate us, to teach us about the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Also we've constructed the world in such a way that it's safe enough for us to survive

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in and yet dangerous enough for learning the valuable lessons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The tables are still hard with corners so it can still run into them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It hurts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So AI needs to solve that problem, not the problem of constructing this super complex

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: organism that leads up to run the whole, to make an apple pie to build the whole universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You need to build the whole universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think the zombie question is something I would leave to the philosophers because, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I will also leave to them the definition of love and what happens between two human beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: when there's a magic that just grabs them like nothing else matters in the world and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: somehow you've been searching for this feeling, this moment, this person your whole life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That feeling, the philosophers can have a lot of fun with that one and also say that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that's just, you can have a biological explanation, you can have all kinds of, it's all fake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it's actually Ayn Rand will say it's all selfish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a lot of different interpretations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'll leave it to the philosophers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The point is the feeling sure as hell feels very real and if my toaster makes me feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: like it's the only toaster in the world and when I leave and I miss the toaster and when

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I come back, I'm excited to see the toaster and my life is meaningful and joyful and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: friends I have around me get a better version of me because that toaster exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That sure as hell feels like a conscious toaster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is that psychologically different to having a dog?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because most people would dispute whether we can say a dog, I would say a dog is undoubtedly

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: conscious but some people say it doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But there's degrees of consciousness and so on but people are definitely much more uncomfortable

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: saying a toaster can be conscious than a dog and there's still a deep connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You could say our relationship with the dog has more to do with anthropomorphism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We kind of project the human being onto it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We can do the same damn thing with a toaster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But you can look into the dog's eyes and you can see that it's sad that it's delighted

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to see you again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't have a dog by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I know it's not that I'm a dog person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Dogs are actually incredibly good at using their eyes to do just that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now I don't imagine that a dog is remotely as close to being intelligent as an AI intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: but it's certainly capable of communicating emotionally with us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But here's what I would venture to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We tend to think because AI plays chess well and is able to fold proteins now well that
