metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it's intelligent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I would argue that in order to communicate with humans, in order to have emotional intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it actually requires another order of magnitude of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not easy to be flawed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Solving a mathematical puzzle is not the same as the full complexity of human to human interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's actually we humans just take for granted the things we're really good at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Non-stop people tell me how shitty people are driving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, humans are incredible at driving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Bipedal walking, walking, object manipulation, we're incredible at this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so people tend to discount the things we all just take for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And one of those things that they discount is our ability, the dance of conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and interaction with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The ability to morph ideas together, the ability to get angry at each other and then to miss

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: To create attention that makes life fun and difficult and challenging in a way that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: meaningful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That is a skill that's learned and AI would need to solve that problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In some sense, what you're saying is AI cannot become meaningfully emotional, let's say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: until it experiences some kind of internal conflict that is unable to reconcile these

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: various aspects of reality or its reality with a decision to make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then it feels sad necessarily because it doesn't know what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I certainly can't dispute that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That may very well be how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think the only way to find out is to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: To build it, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And leave it to the philosophers if it actually feels sad or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The point is the robot will be sitting there alone having an internal conflict, an existential

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: crisis and that's required for it to have a deep, meaningful connection with another

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now, does it actually feel that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I'd like to throw something else at you which troubles me on reading it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Noah Harari's book, 21 Lessons for the 21st Century and he's written about this kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: thing on various occasions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And he sees biochemistry as an algorithm and then AI will necessarily be able to hack that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: algorithm and do it better than humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So there will be AI better at writing music that we appreciate than Mozart ever could

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or writing better than Shakespeare ever did and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Because biochemistry is algorithmic and all you need to do is figure out which bits of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the algorithm to play to make us feel good or bad or appreciate things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And as a biochemist, I find that argument close to irrefutable and not very enjoyable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't like the sound of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's just my reaction as a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You might like the sound of it because that says that AI is capable of the same kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: emotional feelings about the world as we are because the whole thing is an algorithm and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you can program an algorithm and there you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: He then has a peculiar final chapter where he talks about consciousness in rather separate

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: terms and he's talking about meditating and so on and getting in touch with his inner

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't meditate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know anything about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But he wrote in very different terms about it as if somehow it's a way out of the algorithm.

body.input: memories of its former brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Again, I have a feeling that until we understand how to control the electrical fields that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: control development, we're not going to understand how to turn an organoid into a real functional

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But how do we get that understanding?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's so incredibly difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You would have to, I mean, one promising direction, I'd love to get your opinion on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know if you're familiar with the work of DeepMind and AlphaFold with protein folding

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do you think it's possible that that will give us some breakthroughs in biology, trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to basically simulate and model the behavior of trivial biological systems as they become

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: complex biological systems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm sure it will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The interesting thing to me about protein folding is that for a long time, my understanding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: this is not what I work on, so I may have got this wrong, but my understanding is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you take the sequence of a protein and you try to fold it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There are multiple ways in which it can fold and to come up with the correct confirmation

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is not a very easy thing because you're doing it from first principles from a string of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: letters which specify the string of amino acids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But what actually happens is when a protein is coming out of a ribosome, it's coming out

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of a charged tunnel and it's in a very specific environment which is going to force this to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: go there now and then this one to go there and this one to come like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you're forcing a specific conformational set of changes onto it as it comes out of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the ribosome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So by the time it's fully emerged, it's already got its shape and that shape depended on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: immediate environment that it was emerging into one letter, one amino acid at a time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't think that the field was looking at it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If that's correct, then that's very characteristic of science, which is to say it asks very often

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the wrong question and then does really amazingly sophisticated analyses on something having

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: never thought to actually think, well, what is biology doing and biology is giving you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a charged electrical environment that forces you to be this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now, did DeepMind come up through patterns with some answer that was like that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I've got absolutely no idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It ought to be possible to deduce that from the shapes of proteins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It would require much greater skill than the human mind has, but the human mind is capable

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of saying, well, hang on, let's look at this exit tunnel and try and work out what shape

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is this protein going to take and we can figure that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's really interesting about the exit tunnel, but sometimes we get lucky and our, like Jessica

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and science, the simplified view or the static view will actually solve the problem for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In this case, it's very possible that the sequence of letters has a unique mapping to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a structure without considering how it unraveled, so without considering the tunnel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That seems to be the case in this situation where the cool thing about proteins, all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: different shapes they can possibly take, it actually seems to take very specific, unique

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: shapes given the sequence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's forced on you by an exit tunnel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The problem is actually much simpler than you thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Then there's a whole army of proteins which change the conformational state, chaperone

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: proteins, and they're only used when there's some presumably issue with how it came out

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of the exit tunnel and you want to do it differently to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Very often the chaperone proteins will go there and will influence the way in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it falls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's two ways of doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Either you can look at the structures and the sequences of all the proteins and you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: can apply an immense mind to it and figure out what the patterns are and figure out what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: happened, or you can look at the actual situation where it is and say, well, hang on, it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: actually quite simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's got a charged environment and it's forced to come out this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Then the question will be, well, do different ribosomes have different charged environments?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What happens if a chaperone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You're asking a different set of questions to come to the same answer in a way which

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is telling you a much simpler story and explains why it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Rather than saying it could be, this is one in a billion different possible conformational

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: states that this protein could have, you're saying, well, it has this one because that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: was the only one it could take given its setting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, currently humans are very good at that kind of first principles thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It was stepping back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think AI is really good at collecting huge amount of data and a huge amount of data of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: observation of planets and figure out that Earth is not at the center of the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that there's actually a sun orbiting the sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But then you can, as a human being, ask, well, how do solar systems come to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What are the different forces that are required to make this kind of pattern emerge?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then you start to invent things like gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, obviously- Is it an invention?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mixed up the ordering of gravity wasn't considered as a thing that connects planets,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: but we are able to think about those big picture things as human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: AI is just very good to infer simple models from a huge amount of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the question is with biology, we kind of go back and forth how we solve biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Listen, protein folding was thought to be impossible to solve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's a lot of brilliant PhD students that worked one protein at a time trying to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: figure out the structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the fact that I was able to do that- Oh, I'm not knocking it at all, but I think that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: people have been asking the wrong question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But then as the people start to ask better and bigger questions, the AI kind of enters

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the chat and says, I'll help you out with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can I give you another example from my own work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The risk of getting a disease as we get older, there are genetic aspects to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you spend your whole life overeating and smoking and whatever, that's a whole separate

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But there's a genetic side to the risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we know a few genes that increase your risk of certain things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: For probably 20 years now, people have been doing what's called GWAS, which is genome

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: wide association studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you effectively scan the entire genome for any single nucleotide polymorphisms, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is say a single letter change in one place that has a higher association of being linked

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: with a particular disease or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can come up with thousands of these things across the genome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you add them all up and try and say, well, so do they add up to explain the known

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: genetic risk of this disease?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the known genetic risk often comes from twin studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can say that if this twin gets epilepsy, there's a 40 or 50% risk that the other identical

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: twin will also get epilepsy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Therefore, the genetic factor is about 50%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so the gene similarities that you see should account for 50% of that known risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Very often it accounts for less than a 10th of the known risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's two possible explanations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's one which people tend to do, which is to say, ah, well, we don't have enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: statistical power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If we, maybe there's a million, we've only found a thousand of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But if we find the other million, they're weakly related, but there's a huge number

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so we'll account for that whole risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe there's a billion of them, for instance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So that's one way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The other way is to say, well, hang on a minute, you're missing a system here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That system is the mitochondrial DNA, which people tend to dismiss because it's small

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and it doesn't change very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But a few single letter changes in that mitochondrial DNA, it controls some really basic processes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It controls not only all the energy that we need to live and to move around and do everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we do, but also biosynthesis to make the new building blocks, to make new cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And cancer cells very often kind of take over the mitochondria and rewire them so that instead

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of using them for making energy, they're effectively using them as precursors for the building

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: blocks for biosynthesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You need to make new amino acids, new nucleotides for DNA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You want to make new lipids to make your membranes and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So they kind of rewire metabolism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now the problem is that we've got all these interactions between mitochondrial DNA and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the genes in the nucleus that are overlooked completely because people literally throw

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: away the mitochondrial genes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we can see in fruit flies that they interact and produce big differences in risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you can set AI onto this question of exactly how many of these base changes there are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that's just one possible solution that maybe there are a million of them and it does

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: account for the great part of the risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Or the other one is they aren't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's just not there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Actually the risk lies in something you weren't even looking at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And this is where human intuition is very important and just this feeling that, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm working on this and I think it's important and I'm bloody minded about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And in the end, some people are right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It turns out that it was important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Can you get AI to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: To be bloody minded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that hang on a minute.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You might be missing a whole other system here that's much bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's the moment of discovery, of scientific revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm giving up on saying AI can't do something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I've said it enough times about enough things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think there's been a lot of progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And instead I'm excited by the possibility of AI helping humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But at the same time, just like I said, we seem to dismiss the power of humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Like we're so limited in so many ways that in what we feel like dumb ways, we're not

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Our attention, our memory is limited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Our ability to focus on things is limited in our own perception of what limited is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But that actually, there's an incredible computer behind the whole thing that makes this whole

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: system work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Our ability to interact with the environment, to reason about the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's magic there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I am hopeful that AI can capture some of that same magic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But that magic is not going to look like Deep Blue playing chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's going to be more interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I don't think it's going to look like pattern finding either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, that's essentially what you're telling me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It does very well at the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And my point is it works very well where you're looking for the right pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But we are storytelling animals and the hypothesis is a story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a testable story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But a new hypothesis is a leap into the unknown and it's a new story basically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it says this leads to this leads to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's a causal set of storytelling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's also possible that the leap into the unknown has a pattern of its own.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes, it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's possible that it's learnable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm sure it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a nice book by Arthur Koestler on the nature of creativity and he likens it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to a joke where the punchline goes off in a completely unexpected direction and says

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that this is the basis of human creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some creative switch of direction to an unexpected place is similar to a joke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'm not saying that's how it works, but it's a nice idea and there must be some truth in

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's one of these most of the stories we tell are probably the wrong story and probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: going nowhere and probably not helpful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And we definitely don't do as well at seeing patterns in things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But some of the most enjoyable human aspects is finding a new story that goes to an unexpected

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And these are all aspects of what being human means to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe these are all things that AI figures out for itself or maybe they're just aspects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I just have the feeling sometimes that the people who are trying to understand what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we are like, if we wish to craft an AI system which is somehow human-like, that we don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: have a firm enough grasp of what humans really are like in terms of how we are built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But we get a better, better understanding of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I agree with you completely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We try to build the thing and then we go, hang on a minute.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's another system here and that's actually the attempt to build AI that's human-like

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is getting us to a deeper understanding of human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The funny thing that I recently talked to Magnus Carlsen, widely considered to be the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: greatest chess player of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And he talked about AlphaZero, which is a system from DeepMind that plays chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And he had a funny comment, he has a kind of dry sense of humor, but he was extremely

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: impressed when he first saw AlphaZero play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And he said that it did a lot of things that could easily be mistaken for creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So he like, as a typical human, refused to give the system sort of its due because he

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: came up with a lot of things that a lot of people are extremely impressed by, not just

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the sheer calculation, but the brilliance of play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So one of the things that it does in really interesting ways is it sacrifices pieces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So in chess, that means you basically take a few steps back in order to take a step forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You give away pieces for some future reward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that, for us humans, is where art is in chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You take big risks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: For us humans, those risks are especially painful because you have a fog of uncertainty

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: before you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So to take a risk now based on intuition of, I think this is the right risk to take, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: there's so many possibilities that that's where it takes guts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's where art is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's that danger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then Alpha Zero takes those same kind of risks and does them even greater degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But of course, it does it from a, well, you could easily reduce down to a cold calculation

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: over patterns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But boy, when you see the final result, it sure looks like the same kind of magic that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we see in creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We see creative play on the chessboard, but the chessboard is very limited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the question is, as we get better and better, can we do that same kind of creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in mathematics, in programming, and then eventually in biology, psychology, and expand into more

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and more complex systems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I used to go running when I was a boy and fell running, which is say running up and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: down mountains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I was never particularly great at it, but there were some people who were amazingly

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: fast, especially at running down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I realized in trying to do this that there's only really two, three possible ways of doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it and there's only two that work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Either you go extremely slowly and carefully and you figure out, okay, there's a stone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'll put my foot on this stone and then there's a muddy puddle I'm going to avoid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's slow, it's laborious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You figure it out step by step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Or you can just go incredibly fast and you don't think about it at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The entire conscious mind is shut out of it and it's probably the same playing table tennis

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's something in the mind which is doing a whole lot of subconscious calculations about

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: exactly that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You can run at astonishing speed down a hillside with no idea how you did it at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then you panic and you think, I'm going to break my leg if I keep doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I've got to think about where I'm going to put my foot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you slow down a bit and try to bring those conscious mind in and then you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You crash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You cannot think consciously while running downhill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it's amazing how many calculations the mind is able to make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Now the problem with playing chess or something, if you were able to make all of those subconscious

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: kind of forward calculations about what is the likely outcome of this move now in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: way that we can by running down a hillside or something, it's partly about what we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: adapted to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's partly about the reality of the world that we're in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Running fast downhill is something that we better be bloody good at otherwise we're going

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to be eaten.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Whereas trying to calculate multiple, multiple moves into the future is not something we've

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: ever been called on to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Two or three, four moves into the future is quite enough for most of us most of the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So the, yeah, just solving chess may not, we may not be as far towards solving the problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of downhill running as we might think just because we solve chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Still it's beautiful to see creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Humans create machines that are able to create art and art on a chess board and art otherwise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Who knows how far that takes us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Him and I are big fans of yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you're taking votes, his suggestion was you should write your next book on the Fermi

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: paradox.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So let me ask you on the topic of alien life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Since we've been talking about life and we're a kind of aliens, how many alien civilizations

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: are out there do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well the universe is very big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So some, but not as many as most people would like to think is my view because the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that there is a trajectory going from simple cellular life like bacteria all the way through

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems to me there's some big gaps along that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The eukaryotic cell, the complex cell that we have is the biggest of them, but also photosynthesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Another interesting gap is a long gap from the origin of the eukaryotic cell to the first

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That was about a billion years, maybe more than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: A long delay in when oxygen began to accumulate in the atmosphere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So from the first appearance of oxygen in the great oxidation event to enough for animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to respire was close to two billion years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Why so long?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems to be planetary factors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It seems to be geology as much as in anything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We don't really know what was going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So the idea that there's a kind of an inevitable march towards complexity and sentient life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't think he's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Not to say it's not going to happen, but I think it's not going to happen often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So if you think of Earth, given the geological constraints and all that kind of stuff, do

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Earth or really long?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So just to get a sense of, are you more sort of saying that it's very unlikely to get the

body.input: I think the, I mean, the problem, the single great problem at the center of all of that

body.input: But the issue is, what the data is showing, we can track roughly how oxygen was going

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: into the atmosphere from carbon isotopes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So there's two main isotopes of carbon that we need to think about here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One is carbon 12, 99% of carbon is carbon 12.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then 1% of carbon is carbon 13, which is a stable isotope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then there's carbon 14, which is a trivial radioactive, it's trivial in amount.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So carbon 13 is 1% and life and enzymes generally, you can think of carbon atoms as little balls

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: bouncing around, ping pong balls bouncing around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Carbon 12 moves a little bit faster than carbon 13 because it's lighter and it's more likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to encounter an enzyme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so it's more likely to be fixed into organic matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so organic matter is enriched and this is just an observation, it's enriched in carbon

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: 12 by a few percent compared to carbon 13 relative to what you would expect if it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: just equal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if you then bury organic matter as coal or oil or whatever it may be, then it's no

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: longer oxidized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So some oxygen remains left over in the atmosphere and that's how oxygen accumulates in the atmosphere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you can work out historically how much oxygen there must have been in the atmosphere

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: by how much carbon was being buried.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you think, well, how can we possibly know how much carbon was being buried?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the answer is, well, if you're burying carbon 12, what you're leaving behind is more

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: carbon 13 in the oceans and that precipitates out into limestone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you can look at limestones over these ages and work out what's the carbon 13 signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that gives you a kind of a feedback on what the oxygen content.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: up again 10 million years later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And what that seems to be saying is the amount of carbon 12 in the oceans was disappearing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: which is to say it was being oxidized.
