metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I think the chances are pretty limited and the chances of us surviving pretty limited

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: too in the way we're going on at the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The likelihood of us not making ourselves extinct within the next few hundred years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: possibly within the next 50 or 100 years seems quite small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I hope we can do better than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So maybe the only thing that will survive from humanity will be AI and maybe AI, once

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it exists and once it's capable of effectively copying itself and cutting humans out of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: loop, then maybe that will take over the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, there's a kind of inherent sadness to the way you described that, but isn't that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: also potentially beautiful that that's the next step of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I suppose from your perspective, as long as it carries the flame of consciousness somehow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think yes, there can be some beauty to it being the next step of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I don't know if consciousness matters or not from that point of view, to be honest

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But there's some sadness, yes, probably because I think it comes down to the selfishness that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: we were talking about earlier on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I am an individual with a desire not to be kind of displaced from life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I want to stay alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I want to be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I suppose the threat that a lot of people would feel is that we will just be wiped out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So that there will be potential conflicts between AI and humans and that AI will win

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: because it's a lot smarter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Boy, would that be a sad state of affairs if consciousness is just an intermediate stage

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: between bacteria and AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I would see bacteria as being potentially a kind of primitive form of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So the whole of life on earth to my mind is capable of some form of feelings in response

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's not to say it's intelligent, though it's got its own algorithms for intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: nothing comparable with us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it's beautiful what a planet, what a sterile planet can come up with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's astonishing that it's come up with all of this stuff that we see around us and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: either we or whatever we produce is capable of destroying all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It is a sad thought, but it's also hugely pessimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'd like to think that we're capable of giving rise to something which is at least as good

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: if not better than us as AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, I have that same optimism, especially a thing that is able to propagate throughout

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the universe more efficiently than humans can or extensions of humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some merger with AI and humans, where that comes from, bioengineering of the human body

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to extend its life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How to carry that flame of consciousness and that personality and the beautiful tension

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that's within all of us, carry that through to multiple planets, to multiple solar systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: all out there in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's a beautiful vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Whether AI can do that or bioengineered humans can, that's an exciting possibility, and especially

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: meeting other alien civilizations in that same kind of way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do you think aliens have consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If they're organic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So organic, connected to consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think any system which is going to bootstrap itself up from planetary origins, let me finish

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: this and then I come onto something else, but from planetary origins is going to face

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: similar constraints and those constraints are going to be addressed in similar basic

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: engineering ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it will be cellular and I think it will have electrical charges and I think it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: will have to be selected in populations over time and all of these things will tend to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: give rise to the same processes as the simplest fix to a difficult problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So I would expect it to be conscious, yes, and I would expect it to resemble life on

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: earth in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When I was about, I guess, 15 or 16, I remember reading a book by Fred Hoyle called The Black

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Cloud, which I was a budding biologist at the time and this was the first time I'd come

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: across someone that really challenging the heart of biology and saying, you are far too

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: parochial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You're thinking about life as carbon-based.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Here's a life form which is kind of dust, interstellar dust on a solar system scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's a novel, but I felt enormously challenged by that novel because it hadn't occurred to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: me how limited my thinking was, how narrow-minded I was being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And here was a great physicist with a completely different conception of what life could be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And since then, I've seen him attacked in various ways and I'm kind of reluctant to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: say the attacks make more sense to me than the original story, which is to say even in

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: terms of information processing, if you're on that scale and there's a limit to the speed

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of light, how quickly can something think if you're needing to broadcast across the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: solar system, it's going to be slow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not going to hold a conversation with you on the kind of timelines that Fred Hoyle

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: was imagining, or at least not by any easy way of doing it, assuming that the speed of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: light is a limit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then again, you really can't, this is something Richard Dawkins argued long ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and I do think he's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There is no other way to generate this level of complexity than natural selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Nothing else can do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You need populations and you need selection in populations and kind of an isolated interstellar

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: cloud.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Again, there's unlimited time and maybe there's no problems with distance, but you need to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: have a certain frequency of generational time to generate a serious level of complexity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I just have a feeling it's never going to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well as far as we know, so natural selection and evolution is really a powerful tool here

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on earth, but there could be other mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So whenever, I don't know if you're familiar with cellular automata, but complex systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that have really simple components and seemingly move based on simple rules when they're taken

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as a whole, really interesting complexity emerges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know what the pressures on that are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not really selection, but interesting complexity seems to emerge and that's not

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: well understood exactly why that complexity emerges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think there's a difference between complexity and evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So some of the work we're doing on the origin of life is thinking about how do genes arise?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: How does information arise in biology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And thinking about it from the point of view of reacting CO2 with hydrogen, what do you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: get?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, what you're going to get is carboxylic acids, then amino acids.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's quite hard to make nucleotides and it's possible to make them and it's been done and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it's been done following this pathway as well, but you make trace amounts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so the next question, assuming that this is the right way of seeing the question, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: maybe it's just not, but let's assume it is, is well, how do you reliably make more nucleotides

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and how do you become more complex and better at becoming a nucleotide generating machine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the answer is, well, you need positive feedback loops, some form of autocatalysis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So that can work and we know it happens in biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If this nucleotide, for example, catalyzes CO2 fixation, then you're going to increase

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the rate of flux through the whole system and you're going to effectively steepen the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: driving force to make more nucleotides.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And this can be inherited because there are forms of membrane heredity that you can have

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and there are effectively, if a cell divides in two and it's got a lot of stuff inside

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it and that stuff is basically bound as a network, which is capable of regenerating

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: itself, then it will inevitably regenerate itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so you can develop greater complexity, but everything that I've said depends on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: underlying rules of thermodynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There is no evolvability about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's simply an inevitable outcome of your starting point, assuming that you're able

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to increase the driving force through the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You will generate more of the same, you'll expand on what you can do, but you'll never

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: get anything different than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And it's only when you introduce information into that as a gene, as a kind of small stretch

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of RNA, which can be random stretch, then you get real evolvability, then you get biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as we know it, but you also have selection as we know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I don't know how to think about information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's a kind of memory of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not, yeah, at the local level, it's propagation of copying yourself and changing and improving

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: your adaptability to the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But if you look at earth as a whole, it has a kind of memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's the key feature of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In what way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It remembers the stuff it tries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Like if you were to describe earth, I think evolution is something that we experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as individual organisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's how the individual organisms interact with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a natural selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But when you look at earth as an organism in its entirety, how would you describe it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, not as an organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, the idea of Gaia is lovely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: James Lovelock originally put Gaia out as an organism that had somehow evolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: He was immediately attacked by lots of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: He's not wrong, but he backpedaled somewhat because that was more of a poetic vision than

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The science is now called earth systems science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's really about how does the world kind of regulate itself so it remains within the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: limits which are hospitable to life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It does it amazingly well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It is working at a planetary level of kind of integration, of regulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But it's not evolving by natural selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It can't because there's only one of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it can change over time, but it's not evolving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: All the evolution is happening in the parts of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, but it's a self-sustaining organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, it's sustained by the sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So, I mean, you don't think it's possible to see earth as its own organism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it's poetic and beautiful and I often refer to the earth as a living planet, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it's not in biological terms an organism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If aliens were to visit earth, what would they notice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What would be the basic unit of light they would notice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Trees, probably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, it's green and blue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think that's the first thing you'd notice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It stands out from space as being different to any of the other planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So it would notice the trees at first because the green.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, I would.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I noticed the green, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then probably notice, figure out the photosynthesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And then we notice cities second, I suspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So let me actually...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If they arrived at night, they'd notice cities first, that's for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It depends the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You write quite beautifully in Transformers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Once again, I think you opened the book in this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: From space describing earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's such an interesting idea of what earth is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You also, I mean, Hitchhiker's Guide summarizing it as harmless or mostly harmless, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a beautifully poetic thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You open Transformers with from space, it looks gray and crystalline, obliterating the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: blue-green colors of the living earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It is crisscrossed by irregular patterns and convergence striations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a central amorphous density where these scratches seem lighter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: This quote, growth does not look alive, although it has extended out along some lines and there

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is something grasping and parasitic about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Across the globe, there are thousands of them varying in shape and detail, but all of them

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: gray, angular, inorganic, spreading.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yet at night, they light up, glowing up the dark sky, suddenly beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Perhaps these cankers on the landscape are in some sense living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a controlled flow of energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There must be information and some form of metabolism, some turnover of materials.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Are they alive?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No, of course not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They are cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So is there some sense that cities are living beings?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You think aliens would think of them as living beings?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, it would be easy to see it that way, wouldn't it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It wakes up at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They wake up at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Strictly nocturnal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I imagine that any aliens that are smart enough to get here would understand that they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: not living beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: My reason for saying that is that we tend to think of biology in terms of information

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and forget about the cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I was trying to draw a comparison between the cell as a city and the energy flow through

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the city and the energy flow through cells and the turnover of materials.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: An interesting thing about cities is that they're not really exactly governed by anybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There are regulations and systems and whatever else, but it's pretty loose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They have their own life, their own way of developing over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In that sense, they're quite biological.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There was a plan after the Great Fire of London.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Christopher Wren was making plans not only for St. Paul's Cathedral, but also to rebuild

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in large Parisian type boulevards, a large part of the area of central London that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: burnt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It never happened because they didn't have enough money, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's interesting what was in the plan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There were all these boulevards, but there were no pubs and no coffee houses or anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The reality was London just grew up in a set of jumbled streets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It was the coffee houses and the pubs where all the business of the city of London was

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: being done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That was where the real life of the city was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: No one had planned it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The whole thing was unplanned and works much better that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In that sense, the cell is completely unplanned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It's not controlled by the genes in the nucleus in the way that we might like to think that

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: it is, but it's this evolved entity that has the same kind of flux, the same animation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the same life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it's a beautiful analogy, but I wouldn't get too stuck with it as a metaphor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: See, I disagree with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I disagree with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think you are so steeped, and actually the entirety of science, the history of science

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is steeped in a biological framework of thinking about what is life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Not just biological, it's very human-centric too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Human organism is the epitome of life on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think there is some defundamental way in which a city is a living being in the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: way that a human...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It doesn't give rise to an offspring city.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It doesn't work by natural selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It works by, if anything, memes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It works by copying itself conceptually as a mode of being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe memes, maybe ideas are the organisms that are really essential to life on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe it's much more important about the collective aspect of human nature, the collective intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: than the individual intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe the collective humanity is the organism, and the thing that defines the collective

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: intelligence of humanity is the ideas, and maybe the way that manifests itself is cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Or societies, or geographically constrained societies, or nations, and all that kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, from an alien perspective, it's possible that that is the more deeply noticeable thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: not from a place of ignorance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What's noticeable doesn't tell you how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't have any problem with what you're saying really, except that it's not possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: without the humans...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We went from a hunter-gatherer type economy, if you like, without cities, to cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: As soon as we get into human evolution, and culture, and society, and so on, then yes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: there are other forms of evolution, other forms of change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Cities don't directly propagate themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They propagate themselves through human societies, and human societies only exist because humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as individuals propagate themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There is a hierarchy there, and without the humans in the first place, none of the rest

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: of it exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Life is primarily defined by the basic unit on which evolution can operate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it's a really important thing, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We don't have any other better ideas than evolution for how to create life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I never came across a better idea than evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Maybe I'm just ignorant, and I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You mentioned automator, and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't think specifically about that, but I have thought about it in terms of selective

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: units at the origin of life, and the difference between evolvability and complexity, or just

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: increasing complexity, but within very narrowly defined limits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The great thing about genes and about selection is it just knocks down all those limits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It gives you a world of information in the end, which is limited only by the biophysical

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: reality of what kind of an organism you are, what kind of a planet you live on, and so

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Cities and all these other forms that look alive and could be described as alive, because

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: they can't propagate themselves, can only exist as the product of something that did

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: propagate itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a deeply compelling truth to that way of looking at things, but I just hope

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that we don't miss the giant cloud among us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I kind of hope that I'm wrong about a lot of this, because I can't say that my worldview

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: is particularly uplifting, but in some sense, it doesn't matter if it's uplifting or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Science is about what's reality, what's out there, why is it this way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I think there's beauty in that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's beauty in darkness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You write about life and death at the biological level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Does the question of suicide, why live?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Does the question of why the human mind is capable of depression?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Are you able to introspect that from a place of biology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Why our minds, why we humans can go to such dark places?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Why can we commit suicide?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Why can we go suffer, suffer period, but also suffer from a feeling of meaninglessness of

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: going to a dark place that depression can take you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Is this a feature of life or is it a bug?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, if it's a feature of life, then I suppose it would have to be true of other

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: organisms as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: We were talking about dogs earlier on and they can certainly be very sad and upset and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: may mooch for days after their owner died or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And maybe that's true in the greater scheme of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You can justify yourself in terms of society, but society will be gone soon enough as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you end up with a very bleak place just by logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: In some sense, it's surprising that we can find any meaning at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Well, maybe this is where consciousness comes in that we have transient joy, but with transient

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And sometimes with everything in biology, getting the regulation right is practically

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: end and some people are at the misery end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I suspect that too many new editions suffer similar fate, if not through absurd editing

body.input: As it happens, nearly 15 years have passed since the first edition of Power, Sex, Suicide

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: was published, and I am resisting the temptation to make any lame revisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Some say that even Darwin lessened the power of his arguments in The Origin of Species

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I prefer my original to speak for itself, even if it turns out to be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Let me ask the question about writing, both your students in the academic setting, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: also writing, some of the most brilliant writings on science and humanity I've ever read.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you were to talk to young Darwin or the young you, and just young anybody and give

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: advice about how to write and how to write well about these big topics, what would you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: say?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I mean, I suppose there's a couple of points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One of them is, what's the story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What do I want to know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What do I want to convey?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Why does it matter to anybody?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Very often the biggest, most interesting questions, the childlike questions are the one actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that everybody wants to ask, but don't quite do it in case they look stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: One of the nice things about being in science is the longer you're in, the more you realize

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: that everybody doesn't know the answer to these questions and it's not so stupid to

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: ask them after all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Trying to ask the questions that I would have been asking myself at the age of 15, 16 when

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I was really hungry to know about the world and didn't know very much about it and wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to go to the edge of what we know, but be helped to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't want to be too much terminology and so I want someone to keep a clean eye on what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the question is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Beyond that, I've wondered a lot about who am I writing for and that was in the end,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the only answer I had was myself at the age of 15 or 16.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Even if you just don't know who's reading it, but also where are they reading it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Are they reading it in the bath or in bed or on the metro or are they listening to an

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: audio book?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do you want to have a recapitulation every few pages because you read three pages at

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a time or are you really irritated by that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You're going to get criticism from people who are irritated by what you're doing and

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you don't know who they are or what you're going to do that's going to irritate people

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and in the end, all you can do is just try and please yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That means what are these big, fun, fascinating, big questions and what do we know about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and can I convey that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I kind of learned in trying to write, first of all, say what we know and I was shocked

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: in the first couple of books how often I came up quickly against all the stuff we don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you're trying to, I've realized later on in supervising various physicists and mathematicians

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: who are PhD students and their maths is way beyond what I can do, but the process of trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: to work out what are we actually going to model here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What's going into this equation is a very similar one to writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You end up navigating your own path through this landscape and that can be thrilling because

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: you don't know where it's going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I'd like to think that that's one of the reasons my books have worked for people because this

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: sense of the thrilling adventure ride, I don't know where it's going either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So finding the simplest possible way to explain the things we know and the simplest possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: way to explain the things we don't know and the tension between those two, and that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: where the story emerges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Do you find yourself to the point of this editing dial to mostly harmless?

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the first edition, he'd read the whole thing and he said, the first two chapters prevent

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And in the end, I think it's still difficult, it's still biochemistry, but he ended up saying
