metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's no guarantee you're going to get a faculty position at the end of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And there's always the next step to compete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you get a faculty position, you get a tenure and with tenure go full professor, full professor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: then you go to some kind of whatever the discipline is, there's an award.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you're in physics, you're always competing for the Nobel Prize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's different awards and then eventually you're all competing to, I mean, there's always

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So there is no happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Happiness does not lie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you're looking into the future, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if what you're caring about is a career, then it's probably not the one for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If though you can put that aside, and I've also worked in industry for a brief period

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and I was made redundant twice, so I know that there's no guarantee that you've got

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: a career that way either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So live in the moment and try and enjoy what you're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that means really go to the themes that you're most interested in and try and follow

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: them as well as you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that tends to pay back in surprising ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I don't know if you've found this as well, but I found that people will help you often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If they see some light shining in the eye, you're excited about their subject and just

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: want to talk about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And they know that their friend in California has got a job coming up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They'll say, go for this, this guy's all right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They'll use the network to help you out if you really care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And you're not going to have a job two years down the line, but if what you really care

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: about is what you're doing now, then it doesn't matter if you have a job in two years time

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: It'll work itself out if you've got the light in your eye.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And so that's the only advice I can give.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And most people probably drop out through that system because the fight is just not

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: worth it for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: When you have the light in your eye, when you have the excitement for the thing, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: happens is you start to surround yourself with others that are interested in that same

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: thing that also have the light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: If you really are rigorous about this, because I think it does take effort to make...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oh, you've got to be obsessive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But if you're doing what you really love doing, then it's not work anymore is what you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But I also mean the surrounding yourself with other people that are obsessed about the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: thing because...

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Oh, and that takes some work as well, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And luck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Finding the right mentors, the collaborators, because I think one of the problem with the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: PhD process is people are not careful enough in picking their mentors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Those are people, mentors and colleagues and so on, those are people are going to define

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: the direction of your life, how much you love a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: The power of just the few little conversations you have in the hallway, it's incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So you have to be a little bit careful in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Sometimes you just get randomly almost assigned, really pursue, I suppose, the subject as much

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as you pursue the people that do that subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So like both, the whole dance of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: They kind of go together really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah, they really do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: But take that part seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And probably in the way you're describing it, careful how you define success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: You'll never find happiness in success, I don't think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: There's a lovely quote from Robert Louis Stevenson, I think, who said, nothing in life is so disenchanting

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: as attainment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: So, I mean, in some sense, the true definition of success is getting to do today what you

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: really enjoy doing, just what fills you with joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And that's ultimately success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: Success isn't the thing beyond the horizon, the big trophy, the financials.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: I think it's as close as we can get to happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: That's not to say you're full of joy all the time, but it's as close as we can get to a

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: sustained human happiness is by getting some fulfillment from what you're doing on a daily

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: basis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And if what you're looking for is the world giving you the stamp of approval with a Nobel

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: awarded this prize that they deserve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And the other way, if you put too much value into those kinds of prizes and you win them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: and these little moments of discovery, of enjoying beauty in small and big ways all

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: around you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: And I think the bigger ego grows, the more you start to take yourself seriously, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Nick Lane: Origin of Life, Evolution, Aliens, Biology, and Consciousness | Lex Fridman Podcast #318

body.input: What is the nature of human ignorance?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: The following is a conversation with Robert Proctor, historian at Stanford University,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: specializing in 20th century science, technology, and medicine, especially the history of the most

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: controversial aspects of those fields. Please allow me to say a few words about science and

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the nature of truth. The word science is often used as an ideal for a methodology that can help

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: us escape the limitation of any one human mind in the pursuit of truth. The underlying idea here

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: is that individual humans are too easily corrupted by bias, emotion, personal experience,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and the usual human craving for meaning, money, power, and fame. And the hope is that the tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of science can help us overcome these limitations in striving for deeper and deeper understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of objective reality, from physics to chemistry, biology, genetics, and even psychology, cognitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: science, and neuroscience. But history shows that these tools of science are not devoid of human

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: flaws, of influence from human institutions, of manipulation from people in power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: As we talk about in this conversation with Robert Proctor, in the 1930s and 40s, there was the Nazi

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: science and there was communist science, and each had fundamentally different ideas about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: for example, genetics and biology of disease. This history also shows that scientists can be

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: corrupted slowly or quickly by fear, fame, money, or just the ideological narratives of a charismatic

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: leader that convinces each scientist and the scientific community that their work matters

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: for the greater cause of humanity, even if that cause involves the genetic purification

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of a people, the extermination of a cancer, and the unrestricted experimentation on the bodies

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of living beings who do not have a voice, whose suffering will never be heard. All of this for

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the greater good. In some periods of human history, science was deeply influenced by the ideology of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: governments and individuals. In some, less so. The hard truth is that we can't know for sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: about which of the two periods we're living through today. So, let us not too quickly dismiss the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: voices of experts and non-experts alike that ask the simple question of, wait, are we doing the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: right thing here? Are we helping or hurting? Are we adding suffering to the world or are we

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: alleviating it? Most such voices are nothing more than martyrs seeking fame, not truth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and they will be proven wrong. But, some may help prevent future atrocities and suffering at a global

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: scale. Let us then move forward with humility so that history will remember this period as one of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: human flourishing and where science lived up to its highest ideal. This is the Lex Friedman podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: To support it, please check out our sponsors in the description. And now, dear friends,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: here's Robert Proctor. What is the story of science and scientists during the rise,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: rule, and fall of the Third Reich? Well, we tend to think of science as always on the side of liberty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: as always on the side of enlightenment, as always on the side of enlarging human possibility. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: here we have this phenomenon in the 1930s of really the world's leading scientific power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the Third Reich, which collectively had won a big chunk of all the Nobel prizes. Suddenly, they go

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: fascist, they go Nazi with Hitler. And instead of being primarily a source of resistance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: science in many respects actually is a full collaborator in the most horrific forms of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Nazi genocide, Nazi exclusion. And that's kind of a relatively untold story in the sense that when

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: we think of science in the Third Reich, we think of Joseph Mingley injecting dye into the eyes of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: twins, or we think of horrific human experiments, and those are real. But it's also the story of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: huge scientific apparatus of bureaucracy, you could almost say, participating in every phase of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: campaigns of Nazi destruction. And what I looked at in particular in actually my first book was

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: how physicians in particular, but also biomedical science, was collaborating with the regime and

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that it's wrong to think of the Nazi regime as anti-science. It's anti a particular type of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: science. In particular, it was radically against what they call Jewish science, communist science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: certain types of science they did not like. There's a whole nature nurture dispute in that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: period and they're firmly on the side of nature, which interestingly gives rise to a very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: type of science in the Soviet Union, by the way. The Soviet Union is more on the nurture side?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: The Soviet Union is on the side of the nurture side in the dimension of genetics. And this is

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: sort of an untold story. I was actually going to write a book about it until I was barred from

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: access to the Soviet Union. There have been different times in my life where I was a Russianist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: A Russianist. Okay, we're going to have to talk about that, but-

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I got excluded from fulfilling that dream. But one of the things I was going to look at

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: when I got a Fulbright in the 1980s was to go over and look at the anti-Nazi genetics and anthropology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of the Soviets and how a lot of their lysinchois Lamarckism was actually anti-Nazi, anti-genetics

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: on the nurture side of nature. And that's really an untold story. It's an uncomfortable story

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: because it sounds like we might want to make heroes out of the twisting of science in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Soviet Union. But nonetheless, there are these interesting complexities and what's amazing about

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Nazi science is how there was this collaboration. And you're talking about a culture where they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: inventing things like electron microscopy, they're doing all kinds of studies in anthropology. So a

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: lot of that's an untold story. So what was the connection between the ideology and the science?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: If you can just link on it longer. Well, we tend to think of science and ideology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: as completely separate when I think the reality is they're not. If you look at why the Mayans

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: in the seventh and eighth century AD had the world's most accurate calendar, accurate to

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: within 17 seconds per year, that was all part of a ritual practice to celebrate the rise of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Kukulkan, the rise of Venus with what's called the heliacal rising, namely the rising of Venus

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: before the rising of the Sun in which at which moment Venus is destroyed by the light of the Sun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Well, they developed this elaborate calendrical astronomy which required detailed observation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: detailed chronicling of movement of the heavens and particularly the planets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: For the purpose of celebrating this cycle of renewal that they thought was sacred and holy

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and magical. So where's the ideology? Where's the science? There's the sort of instrumentation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the calendrics, the measurement all in the service of this magical moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And I think that's true of a lot of science. I had a friend years ago who was Mennonite and wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to study solar cells and to improve silicon chips to make more efficient solar energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: There was no money for that when Ronald Reagan took office. The budgets for solar and alternative

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: energy were essentially zeroed out and Reagan takes off the solar panels off of the roof of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the White House. So my friend ends up working on hardening silicon chips against nuclear war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So he becomes part of the nuclear war protection defense apparatus even though he wanted to work

body.input: on alternative energy doing very similar work with silicon chips but in a different framework.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And so the practices of science often gets pushed into and is woven into ideological practices.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Sort of in the same way that you get beautiful medieval cathedrals built in service of Catholicism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Well, what's in the mind of an individual scientist? So this process of ideology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: polluting science or is it science empowering ideology? So almost like if we can zoom in and

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: zoom out effortlessly into the individual mind of a scientist then back to the whole scientific

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: community. Do scientists think about nuclear war, about the atrocities committed by the Nazis

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: as they're helping on the minute details of the scientific process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I think sometimes they do and sometimes they don't, right? You think of the chemists working

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to develop the cyanide that will be used to kill Jews in a concentration camp. What are they thinking?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: You can imagine a whole range of thoughts. Maybe they don't know what they're doing. Maybe they do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Maybe they know a little bit but not a lot. Maybe they don't want to know. Maybe they have ways of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: lying to themselves. Maybe they are the one person who agreed to do it and 99 refused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So it's hard if not impossible to know what's in the soul of anyone. But when you have enormous power

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: directing the motion and the currents or the ocean, it's not hard to find people willing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to fill that in, especially if they're narrow technocrats, if they're just doing their job,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: if they're just building the widget. And I think a lot of scientific training is in widget building

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and that leads to the possibility that they can become easily instrumentalized in a particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: action which is maybe horrific or glorious. The other thing to keep in mind is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: science is, as we say, what scientists do. And that can include a lot of things. It can exclude

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: a lot of things. The word science itself is interesting because it's cognate. It actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: comes originally from the Proto-Indo-European skein, meaning to cut or divide. And so it's cognate with

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: scissors, schism, skin. Skin is that which divides you from the world. Shit or scat is that which has

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: been divided from you into the world. And so there's this cognate between science and shit

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: or science and cutting with the whole idea being that you're dividing into parts, classifying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: It's the taxonomic impulse. And to know is to know where something belongs, to divide it into its

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: parts and put it in its proper place. And that taxonomic impulse can be very static. It's actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: one of the things that Darwin had to overcome in recognizing evolution, that the taxonomies are in

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: motion. But it also can lead to a kind of myopia that my job is done when I've classified something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Is this bird an X, a Y, or a Z? And that again can be ideological or it cannot be, but scientists

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: are humans and they're fitting in with a world, with a world practice. And that's limiting. It's

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: kind of inevitable. It's unavoidable. It's hard to be, if not impossible, out of the world that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: we're walking in. Yeah. And it's fascinating because I think ideologies also have an impulse

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: towards forming taxonomies. So being at MIT, I've gotten to learn about this character named Jeffrey

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Epstein. I didn't know who this was until all the news broke out and so on. And it started to wonder

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: how did all these people at MIT that I admire would hang out with this person, just lightly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: just have conversations. I don't mean any of the bigger things, but even just basic conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And I think this has to do, you said scientists are widget builders and taxonomizers. I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: there's power in somebody like the Nazi regime or like a Jeffrey Epstein, just being excited

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: about your widgets and making you feel like the widget serves a greater purpose in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And so it's not like you're, you know, some, sometimes people say scientists want to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: money and, or they have a big kind of ideological drive behind it. I think there's just nice when

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the widget you like building anyway, somehow somebody convinces you, some charismatic person

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that this widget is actually has a grander purpose. And you don't almost feel, think about the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: negative or whether it's positive, just the fact that it's grand is already super exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Yeah. Yeah. I think that's right. I think that's the story of Werner von Braun, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and the fascination with rockets and this will, you know, enlarge something in the world. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: here he is, he's an SS officer, he's working around slave labor. And then, but his rocket

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: then gets compressed into the Western world or the American world and basically launches us to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: moon and we forget about the sauce, how the sausage was made originally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Well, can you talk about him a little bit more? Cause he's such a fascinating character. Cause

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: both. And like, there's this uncomfortable fact that he's, you know, one of the central figures

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that gave birth to the American space exploration efforts. Yeah. He's an interesting figure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: fascinated in a kind of a tunnel vision way with space flight. And he makes these beautiful

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: rockets already beginning in the twenties, early thirties, ends up for a while at Penemunda using

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: people have actually tracked the flights of aborted V2 rockets and found some of these

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: beautiful, beautiful old engines, just the most like works of art. These, these, these engines

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: these, these engines used to rain terror on, on the British. It's interesting because in that same

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: spot, I was hunting for amber, Baltic Amber, cause I'm a stone collector and among the amber

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: collectors there, there's a famous story of the, the Penemunda burn it's called because they find

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and then explodes and creates this big burn, burn on their legs. But the whole Nazi regime is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: is full of things like that. It's full of these scholars who get twisted into a mindset. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: it's also important to realize that people didn't often see what was coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And we look back and we say, how could you X, Y or Z, but before the Holocaust, there's not the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Holocaust. There are versions of it, but things get on a new meaning, gain a new meaning in light

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of subsequent events. And there's a entire propaganda machine that makes it easier for you to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to hold the narrative in your head. Even if you kind of intuitively know there's something really

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: wrong here because of the propaganda, you can kind of convince yourself to be able to sleep at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: That's right. And we have to remember that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: she said he was the most charming sort of person. And that's part of the history too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that we tend to forget when we make a scarecrow image of this rabid raging fanatic. You know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: there's more to it than that. That's really, really, really important to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: when we make a scarecrow, because that gives you actionable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: like it, it forces you to introspect about people in your own life or leaders in your life today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Ones you admire, they're charismatic, they're friendly, they love kids. They,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: they talk about enlightenment. You have to kind of think, all right, am I being duped on certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: things? You have to kind of have a, I mean, that's the problem with Jeffrey Epstein that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: people don't seem to talk about. I don't, I, I never met the guy, but just given the people

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I don't think they're going to be influenced. Ultimately it has to be how you are in the room

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and make it's exactly like you said, the enlightenment. I think that excites the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: scientists. Of course, as a charismatic person, you have to know what to pick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: In terms of what excites you, but that, that is also the fascinating thing to me about Hitler

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: is all of these meetings, even like with Chamberlain inside rooms, whether he was screaming

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: or whatever he was saying, it seems like he was very convincing. There must've been passion in

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: his eyes. There must've been charisma that one-on-one in a quiet conversation, he was convincing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to communism, workers of the world unite. Then for 15 minutes he would rouse the world to capitalism

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: quite convincing in each of those performances. Well, all those ideologies are pretty powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Yeah. Well, it's kind of like the story of two-thirds of the things that Marx calls for

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: or forget about an ideology are very revealing. If we can just linger on this a little bit longer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So one of the labels you can put on your work, I knew as a scholar, as a philosopher of science.

body.input: Value-free science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Value-free science that you use. I mean, it seems like Nazi Germany is an important moment in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I mean, it probably goes up and down. What difficult truths have you learned about the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: scientific process and what hopeful things have you learned about the scientific process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Well, I guess the saddening thing is how easily people can become part of a machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: if there's power, people can be found to follow it. One of the things I work on is big tobacco

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and we'll probably come to that. But it's amazing to me how easily people are willing to work for

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: big tobacco. It's amazing to me how many scientists and physicians were willing to work for the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Nazi regime for multiple reasons. Partly because a lot of them really thought they were doing the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Lord's work. They thought they were cleaning the world of filth. I mean, if you really thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Jews are a parasitic race, why wouldn't you get rid of them? So there's an ontology. There's a theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of the world that they're building on. And interestingly, one that was also present in

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the United States. And one of the things I did find out in my earliest research was that the Nazis

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: had looked lovingly and enviously over at the United States in terms of racial segregation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: racial separation, and saw themselves in a kind of competition to become the world's racial leaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: As the most purified racial form and that this required this kind of cleansing process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And the cleansing meant getting rid of the physically handicapped, getting rid of racial

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: in our food and our water. These were all of a piece. There's a famous illustration that Richard

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Dahl talks about the great cancer theorists of studying in Nazi Germany in the 1930s. And he

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: shown a lecture where cancer cells are shown as Jews and X-rays are shown as storm troopers. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: these storm troopers are killing the cancer cells who are also Jews. And so there's this metaphorical

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: work of cleaning, extermination, sanitation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Purification of the sword.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Purification. There's definitely a kind of purity quest and you see that at multiple levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And so you see how easy it is for people to fall into that given a particular type of disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Given a particular theory. And again, coming back to that earlier point about the scarecrow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: which I think is very important. If we imagine that nothing like this went on here in the United

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: States, that would be a big mistake. The Nazis are looking to save the Redwoods League, to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Aryan supremacists, to the Ku Klux Klan, to the separation of blacks and whites. Blacks were not

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: allowed to join the American Medical Association until after World War II. So you have racial

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: segregation. You have massive sterilization in the United States way before the Nazis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: One of the first things the Nazis do from a racial hygiene point of view is start sterilizing what

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: they call the mentally ill and the physically handicapped. Well, that had been going on

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: since around World War I in the United States and even earlier in certain states in the form of

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: get back to earth from the moon and they have to jettison their toolbox and their ladder and this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and this and this. That's sort of, I think, where the world we're going to be and we're going to

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: have to jettison a lot of things and cigarettes will be one of the things we can get rid of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: RL Let's come back to Nazi Germany for time. You also wrote the book titled The Nazi War on Cancer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: CB Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: RL What is the main storyline and thesis of this book?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: CB Well, I had been researching Nazi medicine. I went over to Germany. I didn't know what I wanted

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: to do. I got a Fulbright. I originally wanted to go to Russia. I went to Germany partly because

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: my girlfriend was going there, Lange Schiebinger. And I was quick with the language. And my old land

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: lady was born in 1900 and I was renting a room, a tiny room in Berlin. And she told me she'd been a

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: nurse in World War I and told me how sad it was that all the mentally ill had died in that war

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and that how the same thing happened in World War II. And she told me about how sad it was that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: she'd never gotten married because there were no German men around after World War I. But I also

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: started taking classes in Germany. And at that time, there were still a few old Nazi professors

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: just about to retire, very old. And I remember there was one guy who would talk about

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the impact on ovaries of women exposed to stress and how this would damage their ovaries and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: this was like people who'd been told they were about to be executed and they would do it before

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and after on these ovaries. One of these horrific experiments. This was a physician in Berlin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And so I got involved with a group of people and really as a kind of intellectual garlic for living

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: in Berlin in 1980, 81. I started reading medical journals from the Nazi period and even the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: librarians didn't like that. I remember the Prozess der Staatsbibliothek in downtown Berlin

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: they're like, why do you wanna, you're not supposed to be reading these old Nazi journals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: These are just medical journals, hundreds and hundreds of journals. And I just read them and

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: read them and read them and read them and looking for details. I'd find like a veterinary medicine

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: journal that would have a joking section where they'd say, oh, we found a cow with a swastika

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: on his forehead, a natural black swastika. Isn't that funny? Or I'd find stories about tobacco.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I find stories about abortion. I'd find stories about excluding Jewish medicine or Jews from

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: medicine or who's been promoted, who's been demoted, who's been Nazified. I discovered there

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: was an entire Nazi physicians league that was just the top Nazi, the most Nazi of the physicians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I discovered that physicians joined the Nazi party in a higher proportion than any other profession

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that they joined the SS in a higher proportion than any other profession.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Why is that? Do you think you do have a sense?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Because the Nazi regime is a kind of sanitary utopia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: It was to create this purified world of that would control the mind and fertility. So

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: gynecologists and psychiatrists were the top. They were the most Nazified of the various

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: medical professions, control the body through sterilization, abortion, control the mind through

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: psychiatry. They killed a lot of the mentally ill and you can read their professional journals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I'm not sure these had ever been read since. I also went to East Germany because remember,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: this is way before the wall fell. They had a very special collection of taboo literature. It's kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of your point about should Mein Kampf be read? Well, of course, East Germany, nowhere close.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: But not only that, Time Magazine couldn't be read and Newsweek couldn't be read. And

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: this file, this chamber that the foreign scholars were allowed to look through had all of the old

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Nazi literature and Nazi scientific literature and Time Magazine and Newsweek and a whole

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: pornography section as well. So all of the taboo topics. So here I'm researching in the West,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I'm researching these topics the librarians didn't even want me to look at in the East.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I was sort of going over there. I would hitchhike over there and overstay my welcome and things

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: like that. But in any event, I noticed that there was this kind of taboo of talking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the big eugenics. I'd already been as a kind of a radical graduate student at Harvard working with

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: all the Marxist biologists there. We'd already had a critique of eugenics and women being excluded

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: from science and South African apartheid was a big deal and Arthur Jensen's, you know, blacks have

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: lower IQs. And so there was a whole nest of controversial hot topics, you know, around

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: sociobiology, around race and IQ, around women and scholarship and so forth. But we weren't looking

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: at Nazi medicine. So I thought I'll look at the big eugenics, not just this smaller stuff. Only

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: 50,000 people are sterilized in California, but there were huge numbers sterilized in Nazi Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So the more I looked into that, I realized there was a book there, but I had also started noticing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: this other weird stuff. Why were they anti-tobacco? Why did they recognize, why were the Nazis the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: first to recognize asbestos as causing mesothelioma? Why did they try to ban food dyes? Why are they

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the first culture in the world to encourage women to do breast self-exams? I told my mom this and

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: she told me that in the 50s, women weren't even supposed to touch their breasts in Texas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: And here in Nazi Germany, you've got these mandatory breast self-exams way before this was

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: done in the United States. You had the first laws banning the X-raying of pregnant women.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Already in the early 1930s, it was standard medical practice. They recognized that this could

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: harm the fetus, harm the race, way before radiation was recognized as a hazard in England

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: or America. I started noticing these things and I have an eye for oddities. I like the weird,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: the contradictory, that which doesn't fit. I remember finding a German magazine, a newspaper

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: actually from 1919 that talked about a Holocaust of 6 million Jews using that language. How could

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: this be? And I researched it. I thought it wasn't even real. And so I went and actually got the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Weird stuff happens, right? That's the source of conspiracy theories, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Exactly. So weird stuff happens, but there's an inkling that couldn't have been written in

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: another time in history. It was much less likely that little coincidence to have happened in another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So it has some kind of resonance with something that captures something deep to the culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Yeah. That's why I'm interested in probing. I mean, history is about seeing the universal

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: through the particular in a way. So you look for the weird particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and then pull at that string to see if there's something there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Is it that weird? I did a project I never published on, it's what I call pseudo swastikas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: which is a lot of companies in Nazi Germany made logos that look pretty much like a swastika.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: It's one of the many things I've filed away. It'd be a great project just to write it. How did this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: kind of visual iconography, you weren't supposed to do that. You weren't supposed to sell your

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: bathroom cream with a swastika on it. So they would do these little things that look pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: much like a swastika. Or I would look at humor. What are they laughing at? What are they smiling at?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I didn't even know Germans had humor. That's a good discovery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Oddly enough, even Hitler had a sense of humor. There's one speech he gives, which is actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and that party. It's actually kind of funny. So we do have this, again, this scarecrow image even

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: of Hitler and his personality and this and that. But I started noticing that there was this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: stuff that looks kind of modern. Hitler being a vegetarian and trying to limit alcohol and this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: and that. And then I got a call, but I'd sort of filed it away. And then I got a call from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: Holocaust Museum, would I like to be the first senior scholar in residence at the Holocaust Museum?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: I said, well, I wasn't really working on Nazi stuff that much anymore, but I did have this idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: maybe looking at how it could be that the Nazis had the world's most aggressive anti-cancer

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: that it could become so powerful that something like the Holocaust could be possible. And they

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: he's talking late into the night about how to cure cancer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

body.input: So for Nazis, racial hygiene encompasses way more than we might think. So it's like purifying it

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Proctor: Nazi Science and Ideology | Lex Fridman Podcast #268
